title: Built to Last
author: Jim Collins & Jerry I. Porras
about: A business study of companies that lasted for generations, and the core values, culture and long-term management habits behind their success.

title: Hands-On Large Language Models
author: Jay Alammar & Maarten Grootendorst
about: A practical programming guide to large language models: transformers, embeddings, semantic search, fine-tuning and building applications with LLMs in Python.

title: Efficient Linux at the Command Line
author: Daniel J. Barrett
about: A software engineering guide to working faster in the Linux shell: commands, pipelines, scripting and the terminal.

title: Data Science from Scratch
author: Joel Grus
about: A programming book that implements data science and machine learning algorithms from scratch in Python, with the statistics and linear algebra behind them.

title: Java Performance
author: Scott Oaks
about: A software engineering book on tuning Java applications: the JVM, garbage collection, the JIT compiler, profiling and performance testing.

title: Range
author: David Epstein
about: A book on learning and expertise arguing that generalists with broad experience often outperform early specialists; psychology of learning and careers.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
about: A novel of magical realism following seven generations of the Buendía family in the fictional town of Macondo; literary fiction.

title: Factfulness
author: Hans Rosling, Ola Rosling & Anna Rosling Rönnlund
about: A book about how the world is getting better, using data on global health, poverty and population, and the instincts that make people misjudge the world.

title: Sapiens

about: A history of humankind from early humans through the agricultural and scientific revolutions to modern societies, money, empires and religion.

title: Homo Deus

title: Velika očekivanja / Great Expectations

about: A classic Victorian novel about the orphan Pip growing up in England, his ambitions and his benefactor; literary fiction.

title: How Not to Be Wrong
author: Jordan Ellenberg
about: A popular mathematics book showing how mathematical thinking, probability and statistics help reason correctly about everyday questions.

title: The God Equation

about: A popular physics book on the search for a theory of everything that unifies gravity and quantum mechanics, including string theory.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
about: A software engineering book on distributed systems and databases: replication, partitioning, consistency, stream and batch processing at scale.

title: Think Again
author: Adam Grant
about: A psychology book about rethinking, doubting your own opinions and changing your mind, and helping others reconsider theirs.

title: Izvan reda: Još 12 pravila za život
author: Jordan B. Peterson
about: Beyond Order: twelve more rules for life. Self-help and psychology on meaning, responsibility, order and chaos in a person's life.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
about: A self-help book on building good habits and breaking bad ones through small, consistent changes in behaviour.

title: System Design Interview – An Insider’s Guide

title: How to Win Friends & Influence People

title: Elon Musk

title: Seven Brief Lessons on Physics

title: Chaos

about: A popular science history of chaos theory: nonlinear dynamics, strange attractors, fractals and the butterfly effect in mathematics and physics.

title: What Every Body Is Saying

about: A former FBI agent's guide to reading body language and non-verbal communication; psychology of people.

title: Structures: Or Why Things Don’t Fall Down

title: Life 3.0
author: Max Tegmark

title: Calculus: An Intuitive and Physical Approach

title: 12 pravila za život: Protuotrov kaosu
author: Jordan B. Peterson
about: 12 Rules for Life: An Antidote to Chaos. Self-help and psychology on meaning, responsibility and how to live a good life.

title: Head First Java
author: Kathy Sierra & Bert Bates
about: A beginner's programming book teaching the Java language and object-oriented programming.

title: Digitalni sustavi
author: Uroš Peruško & Vlado Glavinić
about: A university computer engineering textbook on digital systems: logic gates, Boolean algebra, digital circuits and computer hardware.

title: Moji pronalasci / My Inventions
author: Nikola Tesla

title: The Return of the King
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

title: The Two Towers

title: The Fellowship of the Ring

about: The first volume of The Lord of the Rings, an epic fantasy novel about the hobbit Frodo setting out from the Shire to destroy the One Ring.

title: The Art of War
author: Sun Tzu
about: A classic on strategy, competition and leadership, originally an ancient Chinese treatise on how to win conflicts.

title: Man’s Search for Meaning
author: Viktor E. Frankl
about: A psychiatrist's memoir of surviving Nazi concentration camps and his psychology of finding meaning in life and suffering.

title: Kompendij fizike za srednje škole
author: Antun Kuntarić

title: Influence: The Psychology of Persuasion

about: A psychology book on the principles of persuasion and influence: reciprocity, commitment, social proof, authority, liking and scarcity.

title: Kad tama zavlada
author: Oliver Franić
about: A Croatian novel; fiction.

title: Basic Machines and How They Work
author: U.S. Navy Bureau of Naval Personnel
about: A mechanical engineering primer on simple machines: levers, pulleys, gears, screws, hydraulics and engines.

title: Teorija informacije i kodiranje: zbirka zadataka

title: Operacijski sustavi

about: A university computer science textbook on operating systems: processes, threads, synchronisation, scheduling and memory management.

title: Steve Jobs

title: Probability: For the Enthusiastic Beginner

title: Uvod u teoriju računarstva
author: Siniša Srbljić
about: A university textbook on the theory of computation: automata, formal languages, grammars, Turing machines and computability.

title: Think and Grow Rich
author: Napoleon Hill
about: A classic self-help book on success, wealth and personal achievement through desire, persistence and mindset.

title: A Short History of Nearly Everything

about: A popular science book covering the history of science: the universe, physics, chemistry, geology, evolution and life on Earth.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
